caption: The drawing features a detailed pencil illustration of a shallow bowl with a wide, rounded body and an ornate handle attached to one side. The bowl has a smooth surface and is depicted in shades of gray, with darker shading used to represent depth and form. The handle is elaborate, containing intricate scrollwork and circular patterns, which is further detailed in a close-up view located in a framed box at the bottom left corner of the drawing. In the upper right corner, an additional small box contains a side-profile outline sketch of the bowl and handle, showing their proportions and relative flatness. The objects are arranged on a light beige background, with the primary drawing enclosed in a rectangular border. The signature "Charles Cullen" appears at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Pewter Porringer
